name: Sub dropout
desc: A round Ab-minor sine sub whose groove is defined by what's missing: a stepped mask punches structural dropouts into the 8th-note pattern so the low end stutters and gaps like a glitching sampler. The 7th slot alternates through a i-VII-v-III walk, a slow lpf breathes over 16 cycles, and phrase ends ply the sub double. Warm, heavy, and full of holes.

code.full: note("ab1 ~ ab1 ab1 ~ ab1 <eb2 db2 gb1 bb1> ~").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fast(${rate}).attack(.006).decay(.24).sustain(.2).release(.1).shape(.28).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).mask("1 1 1 0 1 1 <1 0> 1").every(8,x=>x.ply(2)).gain(${gain}).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("[ab1 ab1] ab1 ab1 [ab1 ab2] ab1 [ab1 ab1] <eb2 gb1> [db2 ab1]").add(note(${root})).s("sine").fast(${rate}).attack(.005).decay(.2).sustain(.15).release(.07).shape(.35).lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).mask("1 0 1 1 1 0 1 1").lastOf(4,x=>x.ply(2)).gain(${gain}).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
